ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: at the top of the figure is a p-isopropyl-substituted aryl imine fragment, in which aryl-N forms an N=C bond with a methyl-substituted imine carbon; this imine carbon is also connected to the right-side chain segment containing a cyclohexyl substituent. Below is another p-isopropyl-substituted aromatic ring, with NH attached at a neighboring position of the aromatic ring and connected to the cyclohexyl-substituted center. The curved arrows in the figure show that the π electrons of N=C are pushed toward nitrogen, while the π electrons of the lower aromatic ring form a bond toward the imine carbon, accompanied by NH/aromatic-ring electron rearrangement. Then reason: according to the specified labels, write the upper aryl imine as ArA-N=C(CH3)-, the imine carbon as Cα, the lower aromatic ring as ArB, and the cyclohexyl-containing amine as ArB-NH-C(cyclohexyl). The curved arrows cause the N=C π electrons to migrate to the upper imine nitrogen, generating the departing neutral p-isopropylaniline fragment; the π electrons of the lower aromatic ring form a new Cα-ArB bond with Cα, and through adjacent π-bond/lone-pair electron migration restore a neutral fused enamine structure. After normalizing hydrogens and valences, the product is the cyclized lower fragment plus free p-isopropylaniline.

raw_record.question_text: An 'arrow-pushing' diagram is a common type of chemical image used to illustrate electron flow in mechanistic steps. Please choose the SMILES expression for the molecules(state) after the electron has been relocated, as depicted in the image. <image_1>

method.method_draft: Label the upper aryl imine fragment as ArA-N=C(CH3)-, the imine carbon as Cα, the lower aryl ring as ArB, and the cyclohexyl-bound amine as ArB-NH-C(cyclohexyl). Apply the curved arrows exactly: move the N=C π electrons onto the upper imine nitrogen so the ArA nitrogen becomes the detached aniline fragment; use the lower arene π electrons to form the new Cα-ArB bond; shift the adjacent π/lone-pair electrons as drawn so the lower aryl ring and the tethered cyclohexyl amine reach the neutral fused/enamine product. After normalizing hydrogens, write the two products as the cyclized lower fragment plus free para-isopropylaniline: CC(C)c1cc2c(NC3(CC(C)CCC3)C=C2C)cc1.CC(C)c4ccc(N)cc4.

再推理：按指定标记，将上方芳基亚胺写作ArA-N=C(CH3)-，亚胺碳为Cα，下方芳环为ArB，含环己基的胺为ArB-NH-C(cyclohexyl)。弯箭头使N=C π电子迁移到上方亚胺氮，生成脱离的中性对异丙基苯胺片段；下方芳环的π电子与Cα形成新的Cα-ArB键，并通过相邻π键/孤对电子迁移恢复中性的稠合烯胺结构。规范化氢和价态后，产物为环化的下方片段加游离对异丙基苯胺。
